entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You were in a dark tunnel with no l..."
entries.dialogueText:
You were in a dark tunnel with no light at the end. 

A faint voice echoed in your head. It was Lucita, growing further and further away from you.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...could not make sense of what was..."
entries.dialogueText: ...could not make sense of what was happening.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...ran after her as fast as you cou..."
entries.dialogueText: ...ran after her as fast as you could.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...told her to stay with you."
entries.dialogueText: ...told her to stay with you.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You were in a dark tunnel with no l..."
entries.dialogueText:
You were in a dark tunnel with no light at the end. 

A faint voice echoed in your head. It was Pabel, growing further and further away from you.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...ran after him as fast as you cou..."
entries.dialogueText: ...ran after him as fast as you could.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...could not make sense of what was..."
entries.dialogueText: ...could not make sense of what was happening.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...told him to stay with you."
entries.dialogueText: ...told him to stay with you.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You were in a dark tunnel with no l..."
entries.dialogueText:
You were in a dark tunnel with no light at the end. 

A faint voice echoed in your head. It was Lena, growing further and further away from you.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You heard a deep bellow from right..."
entries.dialogueText:
You heard a deep bellow from right behind you. It sounded like something was grunting within the darkness.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...felt the brush of something soft..."
entries.dialogueText: ...felt the brush of something soft.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A rat was looking at you. You ha..."
entries.dialogueText:
A rat was looking at you.

You had lost track of the passage of time long ago. It had been at least a few months, you thought, but it did not matter anymore.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...did not dare to move."
entries.dialogueText: ...did not dare to move.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was the most magnificent bull yo..."
entries.dialogueText:
It was the most magnificent bull you had ever seen. Its hair was black as night, its eyes red with rage.

With a challenging roar, the bull pawed the ground and charged at you.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...ran for your life."
entries.dialogueText: ...ran for your life.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...turned around to face it."
entries.dialogueText: ...turned around to face it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was the most magnificent bull yo..."
entries.dialogueText:
It was the most magnificent bull you had ever seen. Its hair was black as night, its eyes red with rage.

With a challenging roar, the bull pawed the ground and charged at you.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But, there was no escape. It appear..."
entries.dialogueText:
But, there was no escape. It appeared right before you. It was the most magnificent bull you had ever seen. Its hair was black as night, its eyes red with rage.

With a challenging roar, the bull pawed the ground and charged at you.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The cell door opened."
entries.dialogueText: The cell door opened.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The warden entered your cell to rea..."
entries.dialogueText:
The warden entered your cell to read you your final rites before the execution.

He asked what you wanted for your final meal.

You requested...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...nothing."
entries.dialogueText: ...nothing.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...Toras flambeé."
entries.dialogueText: ...Toras flambeé.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...a rizetta."
entries.dialogueText: ...a rizetta.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After your meal, you were dragged t..."
entries.dialogueText:
After your meal, you were dragged through a tunnel, just like the one from your dream.

You looked around, but...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...the bull was nowhere to be found..."
entries.dialogueText: ...the bull was nowhere to be found.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Among the cheers of the crowd, the..."
entries.dialogueText:
Among the cheers of the crowd, the executioners made you kneel for the guillotine.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The blade dropped."
entries.dialogueText: The blade dropped.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And so passed His Majesty, Romus of..."
entries.dialogueText: And so passed His Majesty, Romus of House Toras.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The last of his name."
entries.dialogueText: The last of his name.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was all for naught. You looke..."
entries.dialogueText:
It was all for naught.

You looked up and saw the sharp blade glimmering in the sun.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...did not resist at all."
entries.dialogueText: ...did not resist at all.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...tried to get away with all your..."
entries.dialogueText: ...tried to get away with all your might.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...accepted your fate with dignity."
entries.dialogueText: ...accepted your fate with dignity.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You looked up and saw the sharp bla..."
entries.dialogueText: You looked up and saw the sharp blade glimmering in the sun.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...a bottle of wine."
entries.dialogueText: ...a bottle of wine.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The second-to-last of his name."
entries.dialogueText: The second-to-last of his name.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You were in a dark tunnel with no l..."
entries.dialogueText:
You were in a dark tunnel with no light at the end. 

A faint voice echoed in your head. It was your mother, growing further and further away from you.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...cursed her for giving birth to y..."
entries.dialogueText: ...cursed her for giving birth to you.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "At least you fought for something g..."
entries.dialogueText: At least you fought for something greater, for a better world.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You couldn't help but wish you had..."
entries.dialogueText: You couldn't help but wish you had crushed your enemies when you had the chance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rumors seeped through the prison wa..."
entries.dialogueText:
Rumors seeped through the prison walls. The coupists had crushed Rizia's nascent democracy and were unleashing a violent crackdown on the reformists.

The House of Delegates had been dismantled.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...felt nothing but the weight of t..."
entries.dialogueText: ...felt nothing but the weight of time.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...counted each day, a silent rebel..."
entries.dialogueText: ...counted each day, a silent rebellion against your fate.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It seemed pointless now, worrying a..."
entries.dialogueText: It seemed pointless now, worrying about what could have been.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Power had been a fragile thing, bes..."
entries.dialogueText:
Power had been a fragile thing, bestowed and then forcibly taken away. In the Citadel, days turned into weeks. 

The same walls that had once confined criminals and traitors during your reign now held you captive.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...found bitter irony in this cruel..."
entries.dialogueText: ...found bitter irony in this cruel twist of fate.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All three noble houses united behin..."
entries.dialogueText:
All three noble houses united behind Hugo after you were declared a traitor to the Crown.

Their forces swept across the kingdom while you were behind bars, eliminating your last remaining loyalists and other threats to their rule.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Houses Toras and Sazon united behin..."
entries.dialogueText:
Houses Toras and Sazon united behind Hugo after you were declared a traitor to the Crown.

While you sat behind bars, their forces swept across the kingdom, crushing your last remaining loyalists and using the chaos to weaken House Azaro.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Houses Toras and Azaro united behin..."
entries.dialogueText:
Houses Toras and Azaro united behind Hugo after you were declared a traitor to the Crown.

While you sat behind bars, their forces swept across the kingdom, crushing your last remaining loyalists and using the chaos to strike House Sazon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Houses Sazon and Azaro united behin..."
entries.dialogueText:
Houses Sazon and Azaro united behind General Taddeus after you were declared a traitor to the Crown.

While you sat behind bars, their forces swept across the kingdom, using the opportunity to crush House Toras and your loyalists.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "While you sat behind bars, House Sa..."
entries.dialogueText:
While you sat behind bars, House Sazon's forces swept across the kingdom, seizing the opportunity to strike Houses Toras and Azaro.

In response, the Azaros rallied behind Hugo to stop them, preventing the country from descending to chaos.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "And then came the news -- Hugo had..."
entries.dialogueText: And then came the news -- Hugo had been crowned king.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "While you sat behind bars, House Az..."
entries.dialogueText:
While you sat behind bars, House Azaro's forces swept across the kingdom, seizing the opportunity to strike Houses Toras and Sazon.

In response, the Sazons rallied behind Hugo to stop them, preventing the country from descending to chaos.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "And then came the news -- Taddeus h..."
entries.dialogueText: And then came the news -- Taddeus had been crowned king.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "News had been scarce since you were..."
entries.dialogueText:
News had been scarce since you were branded a traitor to the Crown and thrown into jail by Titus.

But then, word arrived -- Hugo had been officially crowned king in a grand public ceremony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rumors seeped through the prison wa..."
entries.dialogueText:
Rumors seeped through the prison walls. The Crown's forces were crushing revolutionaries and the reformists across Rizia.

Adarfo Sotelato's movement, once a beacon of hope, had withered into nothing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "News had been scarce since you were..."
entries.dialogueText:
News had been scarce since you were arrested by the coupists.

But then, word arrived -- Hugo had been officially crowned king in a grand public ceremony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "News had been scarce since you were..."
entries.dialogueText:
News had been scarce since you were arrested by the coupists.

But then, word arrived -- Rico had been officially crowned king in a grand public ceremony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "News had been scarce since you were..."
entries.dialogueText:
News had been scarce since you were arrested by the coupists.

But then, word arrived -- Lucita had been officially crowned queen in a grand public ceremony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "News had been scarce since you were..."
entries.dialogueText:
News had been scarce since you were arrested by the coupists.

But then, word arrived -- Taddeus had been officially crowned king in a grand public ceremony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "News had been scarce since you were..."
entries.dialogueText:
News had been scarce since you were arrested by the coupists.

But then, word arrived -- Angelica had been officially crowned queen in a grand public ceremony.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The days passed."
entries.dialogueText: The days passed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...by the royal decree of King Hugo..."
entries.dialogueText: ...by the royal decree of King Hugo Toras, your life shall be spared, your honor reinstated, and your family granted amnesty.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your release came as part of the So..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your release came as part of the Sovereign Transition and Clemency Act signed by Rizia's new monarch.

On your way out you were handed a letter that read...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...under the royal decree of King R..."
entries.dialogueText: ...under the royal decree of King Rico Toras, your life is hereby preserved, your honor reclaimed, and the safety of your family assured.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...by the royal decree of King Tadd..."
entries.dialogueText: ...by the royal decree of King Taddeus Azaro, your life is spared, your honor restored, and your family's sanctity upheld.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...by the royal decree of Queen Luc..."
entries.dialogueText: ...by the royal decree of Queen Lucita Azaro, your life is spared, your honor redeemed, and your family's well-being guaranteed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...by the royal decree of Queen Ang..."
entries.dialogueText: ...by the royal decree of Queen Angelica Sazon, your existence is spared, your honor renewed, and your family's safety preserved.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "To circumvent any potential for pol..."
entries.dialogueText:
To circumvent any potential for political unrest in the capital, Queen Lucita moved your imprisonment to Iza, far from Porte Drazon. 

You were relocated to a slightly better jail cell with a view of the city skyline.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Fully free at last, life could begi..."
entries.dialogueText: Fully free at last, life could begin anew. For the first time since birth, choosing your destiny was in your hands.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...by the royal decree of Queen Luc..."
entries.dialogueText: ...by the royal decree of Queen Lucita Azaro, you were to be released in one month's time.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "A fresh start awaited."
entries.dialogueText: A fresh start awaited.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At some point, you lost track of th..."
entries.dialogueText: At some point, you lost track of the passage of time. Had you been in the Citadel for weeks, or months? There was no way of knowing.

entries.title: Narrator: "Thousands were being released from..."
entries.dialogueText:
Thousands were being released from prison. Their freedom came as part of the Sovereign Transition and Clemency signed by the new monarch. But for you, there was no amnesty.

The warden handed you a letter that read...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wanted you to know that I have g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted you to know that I have given birth to our son, {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}, the future King of Rizia. May he grow up to be a more noble and honorable man than his father. Sincerely, Queen Lucita."

entries.dialogueText: "I am writing this from exile -- I will not tell you where for my protection and that of our newborn son, {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}. I will raise him well and keep him safe until the day you are able to join us. Love always, Lucita."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wanted you to know that I have g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted you to know that I have given birth to your son, {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}. May he grow up to be a more noble and honorable man than his father. Yours truly, Lucita."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wanted you to know that I tried..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted you to know that I tried to see you, but they would not allow it. Not family, they said. As if love needs permission. But I will not give up hope. Bi mare volu, un oxit solu -- P."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Darling -- the bastards are pressu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Darling -- the bastards are pressuring me to make a show of fealty to the new regime. No matter what you see or read in there, know that in my heart there is only one true King of Rizia, and that's my son. Love always, Estela."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After months, your family was final..."
entries.dialogueText:
After months, your family was finally given allowance to visit you in prison.

You embraced Estela and Vina when they came to see you for the first time since you were arrested.

Your daughter told you that the new leadership had forced her to sign a document renouncing her claim to the throne. In exchange, she and Axel were allowed to live in Pales in peace.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After months, your family was final..."
entries.dialogueText:
After months, your family was finally given allowance to visit you in prison.

You embraced Estela and Vina when they came to see you for the first time since you were arrested.

Vina told you that life in Pales was good, and that she and Axel were trying to get you extradited to the Grand Duchy.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After months, your family was final..."
entries.dialogueText:
After months, your family was finally given allowance to visit you in prison.

You embraced Estela when she came to see you for the first time since you were arrested. A threat to nobody, she'd been granted a modest residence of her own in Porte Drazon.

Vina wasn't with her. Your mother assured you she'd visit when she was ready.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After months, your family was final..."
entries.dialogueText:
After months, your family was finally given allowance to visit you in prison.

You embraced Estela and Vina when they came to see you for the first time since you were arrested.

Vina told you that she and Rico had filed for divorce. 

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After months, your family was final..."
entries.dialogueText:
After months, your family was finally given allowance to visit you in prison.

You embraced Estela and Vina when they came to see you for the first time since you were arrested.

Vina told you that she and Manus were fighting to get you amnesty.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After months, your family was final..."
entries.dialogueText:
After months, your family was finally given allowance to visit you in prison.

You embraced Estela and Vina when they came to see you for the first time since you were arrested.

They told you that they were doing anything they can to get you amnesty.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After months, your family was final..."
entries.dialogueText:
After months, your family was finally given allowance to visit you in prison.

You embraced Estela when she came to see you for the first time since you were arrested.

A threat to nobody, she'd been granted a modest residence of her own in Porte Drazon, not far from the palace.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You heard rumors that King Hugo Tor..."
entries.dialogueText:
You heard rumors that King Hugo Toras was garnering respect from older citizens, who hailed him as "The Protector King."

According to the Royal Herald, he was championing education and traditional values.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You heard rumors that Queen Angelic..."
entries.dialogueText:
You heard rumors that Queen Angelica Sazon garnered much respect from the Rizian gentry. 

According to the Royal Herald, she championed liberal values without losing sight of tradition.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You heard rumors that King Ricardus..."
entries.dialogueText:
You heard rumors that King Ricardus Toras had instilled a newfound sense of nationalism and monarchism in Rizia. 

According to the Royal Herald, he was about to institute strict border bans and incorporate Su Omina into the kingdom's national security forces.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You heard rumors that Queen Lucita..."
entries.dialogueText:
You heard rumors that Queen Lucita Azaro's popularity had extended beyond Cardesse-Montaklar, overshadowing the legacy of House Toras. 

According to the Royal Herald, she planned to expand the powers of the Rizian Armed Forces, giving them a greater role in government even during peacetime.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You heard rumors that King Taddeus..."
entries.dialogueText:
You heard rumors that King Taddeus Azaro infused a newfound sense of militarism and monarchism in Rizia. 

According to the Royal Herald, he planned to expand the powers of the Rizian Armed Forces, giving them a greater role in government even during peacetime.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rumors seeped through the prison wa..."
entries.dialogueText:
Rumors seeped through the prison walls. The Crown's forces were crushing the reformists and their collaborators across Rizia.

The reform movement, once a beacon of hope, had withered into nothing but a stillborn dream.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You couldn't care less."
entries.dialogueText: You couldn't care less.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You cursed his name."
entries.dialogueText: You cursed his name.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Long live the King."
entries.dialogueText: Long live the King.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You cursed her name."
entries.dialogueText: You cursed her name.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...listened in silence, unsure what..."
entries.dialogueText: ...listened in silence, unsure what to feel.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...missed your daughter more than a..."
entries.dialogueText: ...missed your daughter more than anything.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...clung to her every word, despera..."
entries.dialogueText: ...clung to her every word, desperate to know about the world outside your four walls.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...said they shouldn't waste their..."
entries.dialogueText: ...said they shouldn't waste their time on false hope.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...smiled, knowing that even in pri..."
entries.dialogueText: ...smiled, knowing that even in prison, you were not forgotten.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rumors seeped through the prison wa..."
entries.dialogueText:
Rumors seeped through the prison walls. The Crown's forces were crushing the unrest and all reformist collaborators across Rizia.

The reform movement, once a beacon of hope, had withered into nothing but a stillborn dream.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "At least order had been restored."
entries.dialogueText: At least order had been restored.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The next day, you received news of..."
entries.dialogueText:
The next day, you received news of the Palesian forces' unconditional surrender.

Newspapers were filled with images of Axel Reinhart, bound and escorted by Rizian soldiers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The next day, you received news tha..."
entries.dialogueText:
The next day, you received news that the war had come to an end -- not in conquest, but in compromise. Rizia and Pales had agreed to settle with pre-war borders, neither side claiming victory.

Newspapers were filled with images of Axel Reinhart, walking tall as he left the negotiation table.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "War, war never changes."
entries.dialogueText: War, war never changes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The next day, a chilling announceme..."
entries.dialogueText:
The next day, a chilling announcement halted the continent: a devastating nuclear exchange had ravaged Holsord and parts of Rumburg.

The AN moved swiftly to contain the crisis, but their intervention did little to stop the unraveling of peace. Instead, tensions exploded across Eastern Merkopa, igniting a continental conflict.

The Pales-Rizia war, once a regional struggle, turned into another battleground in a far greater catastrophe.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Little by little, your legacy disso..."
entries.dialogueText:
Little by little, your legacy dissolved into obscurity. 

The eight years you spent as king became little more than a footnote in history, while you remained trapped in the past.

Estela's visits became less and less frequent as her health failed. Then, they stopped entirely.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Days later, the news reached your c..."
entries.dialogueText:
Days later, the news reached your cell: War had broken out between Rumburg and Sordland.

The toll was already steep, with no end in sight. While the battles themselves were distant, the war's impact was felt in Rizia, where Rumburgian refugees were reluctant to return to their ravaged homeland.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You worried about the future."
entries.dialogueText: You worried about the future.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The next day, a chilling announceme..."
entries.dialogueText:
The next day, a chilling announcement halted the continent: a devastating nuclear exchange had ravaged Holsord and parts of Rumburg.

The AN moved swiftly to contain the crisis, but their intervention did little to stop the unraveling of peace. Instead, tensions exploded across Eastern Merkopa, igniting a continental conflict.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "War, war never changes."
entries.dialogueText: War, war never changes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You were happy you didn't have to c..."
entries.dialogueText: You were happy you didn't have to clean up the mess.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You wished you could take charge of..."
entries.dialogueText: You wished you could take charge of the situation.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...nodded, but all you wanted was t..."
entries.dialogueText: ...nodded, but all you wanted was to see Pabel.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Years passed."
entries.dialogueText: Years passed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A year later, Vina visited once mor..."
entries.dialogueText:
A year later, Vina visited once more, bringing along a surprise: her baby daughter Lena, named after her grandmother.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some time later, you received a sur..."
entries.dialogueText:
Some time later, you received a surprise visitor: Vina.

After the war ended, she had finally been allowed to leave Pales. 

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...embraced her."
entries.dialogueText: ...embraced her.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...couldn't hold back your tears."
entries.dialogueText: ...couldn't hold back your tears.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...apologized for everything."
entries.dialogueText: ...apologized for everything.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...wished the best for them."
entries.dialogueText: ...wished the best for them.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...urged her to go elsewhere, knowi..."
entries.dialogueText: ...urged her to go elsewhere, knowing she'd never truly be safe at home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Inside the walls of your cell, time..."
entries.dialogueText:
Inside the walls of your cell, time had no meaning. The days blurred together, indistinguishable from one another.

You had nothing left but your thoughts—fragments of a life that once was, replayed over and over, growing fainter and fainter.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Until it faded away."
entries.dialogueText: Until it faded away.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Until one day, the cell door opened..."
entries.dialogueText: Until one day, the cell door opened.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You felt your mind slipping away."
entries.dialogueText: You felt your mind slipping away.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Until one day, the cell door opened..."
entries.dialogueText: Until one day, the cell door opened.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rom -- the new regime reinstituted..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rom -- the new regime reinstituted the homosexuality ban, and your brute of a bodyguard turned me in immediately. No matter what happens to either of us, I love you and regret nothing. Bi mare volu, un oxit solu -- P."

entries.dialogueText:
After months, your family was finally given allowance to visit you in prison.

You embraced Estela and Vina when they came to see you for the first time since you were arrested.

Vina told you that the new leadership had forced her to sign a document renouncing her claim to the throne. Now that she no longer had to carry on the royal bloodline, she and Rico had filed for divorce.

After months, your family was finally given allowance to visit you in prison.

You embraced Estela and Vina when they came to see you for the first time since you were arrested.

Vina told you she'd been forced to sign an official document renouncing her claim to the throne. She and her grandmother were now doing everything they could to get you amnesty.

You...

entries.title: Narrator: "Some time later, you received a sur..."
entries.dialogueText:
Some time later, you received a surprise visitor, a woman you barely recognized. Vina.

After her escape from Palas Rezna, she'd traveled from country to country before secretly moving in with Manus in Kyrute. They now had a daughter together: Lena.

You...

After her escape from Palas Rezna, she'd traveled from country to country before settling down as a commoner in Kyrute.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A year later, Vina finally visited..."
entries.dialogueText:
A year later, Vina finally visited you. Although she still didn't want to be close with you, there was someone she wanted you to meet: her new baby daughter, Lena.

You...

entries.title: Player_Romus: "...felt bitter that you couldn't wa..."
entries.dialogueText: ...felt bitter that you couldn't watch her grow up.
